_: HOW LEARNERS MOVE THROUGH THE QUALIFICATION.
Of those who begin a level, a share complete it; of those who complete
it, a share begin the next level in the following term. Both rise with
the level, because a learner who has reached B2 has already shown the
commitment an A1 entrant has not. These are the plan's own assumptions,
and they are the first quantities the College replaces with its own
measurement: continuation is, on the plan's own stress test, the
variable the institution is most sensitive to.

completion.s: Share of those beginning a level who complete it

continuation.s: Share of those completing a level who begin the next in the following term
continuation.u: share, level I to II through V to VI

entryLevel.s: The level at which new learners are placed: most enter at A1 or A2, few at C1 or above
entryLevel.u: share of new enrolments by entry level
